_comment: SURGX media registry AND THE LICENCE GATE. Absence of a licence record is a REFUSAL, not a default-allow (assets/kardiox-learn/ holds 872 images with no manifest and no licence record; that is the failure mode this exists to prevent). An uncleared entry is a WORK ORDER: it must say what is needed and where to look, and it renders as a caption plus 'visual pending' until it is cleared. Only self-authored inline SVG is cleared today, because it is the one kind of media that needs no sourcing and whose provenance we can honestly assert.

med.surgx.appendix-anatomy.title: Finding the appendix
med.surgx.appendix-anatomy.caption: The three taeniae coli converge on the base of the appendix. Following one distally locates the base whatever the position of the tip.

med.surgx.calot-triangle.title: The hepatocystic triangle
med.surgx.calot-triangle.caption: Bounded by the cystic duct, the common hepatic duct and the inferior border of the liver. Lateral traction on the infundibulum opens it; cephalad traction closes it and aligns the cystic duct with the common bile duct.

med.surgx.cvs-diagram.title: The Critical View of Safety
med.surgx.cvs-diagram.caption: Three criteria, all required: the hepatocystic triangle cleared of fat and fibrous tissue, the lower third of the gallbladder separated from the cystic plate, and exactly two structures entering the gallbladder.

med.surgx.inguinal-canal.title: Direct, indirect and femoral
med.surgx.inguinal-canal.caption: The inferior epigastric vessels separate an indirect hernia (lateral, through the deep ring) from a direct one (medial, through Hesselbach triangle). A femoral hernia passes below the inguinal ligament, medial to the vein.

med.surgx.lap-quadrants.title: The exploration sequence
med.surgx.lap-quadrants.caption: The same order every time: supracolic, small bowel from the duodenojejunal flexure to the caecum, colon, both paracolic gutters, pelvis, retroperitoneum. The numbering is the point.

med.surgx.appendix-base.caption: Endoscopic view of the appendix base cleared circumferentially, with healthy caecal wall visible on both sides before an endoloop is applied.
med.surgx.appendix-base.note: WORK ORDER: an intra-operative still showing a properly cleared base. Source it either from an openly licensed surgical atlas (CC BY or CC0 only) or produce it in-house with documented patient consent for educational use. Do NOT take a frame from a commercial atlas or a YouTube video.

med.surgx.abscess-deloculation.caption: A multiloculated abscess cavity in cross-section, showing why a single stab incision drains only one compartment.
med.surgx.abscess-deloculation.note: WORK ORDER: authorable in-house as an inline SVG in surgx-diagrams.js, in the same style as the other five. Until it is drawn it stays refused. Estimated effort: one diagram.

med.surgx.app-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.app-step-01.caption: The site is marked by the surgeon on an awake patient, before anaesthesia.

med.surgx.app-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.app-step-02.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the knife touches skin.

med.surgx.app-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.app-step-03.caption: The antibiotic goes in before the incision, and clot prevention is in place.

med.surgx.app-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.app-step-04.caption: Head-down with left tilt: gravity clears the small bowel off the right iliac fossa.

med.surgx.app-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.app-step-05.caption: Prepare widely enough to convert or extend the incision without re-prepping.

med.surgx.app-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.app-step-06.caption: Open (Hasson) entry: the first port goes in under direct vision, clear of the bowel.

med.surgx.app-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.app-step-07.caption: Working ports on the left, aimed at the right iliac fossa, avoiding the abdominal wall vessels.

med.surgx.app-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.app-step-08.caption: Survey the terminal ileum, pelvis and ovaries before committing to the appendix.

med.surgx.app-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.app-step-09.caption: Grasp the caecum, not the appendix, and follow the taenia coli to the base.

med.surgx.app-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.app-step-10.caption: Control the mesoappendix and appendicular artery close to the appendix, before the base.

med.surgx.app-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.app-step-11.caption: Two endoloops on healthy caecal wall, then divide above them leaving a short cuff.

med.surgx.app-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.app-step-12.caption: Aspirate contamination where it pools; do not spread it.

med.surgx.app-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.app-step-13.caption: An infected appendix leaves in a retrieval bag and never touches the wound.

med.surgx.app-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.app-step-14.caption: Check the stump and the mesoappendix for bleeding before closing.

med.surgx.app-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.app-step-15.caption: The count is a two-person check, done before closing.

med.surgx.app-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.app-step-16.caption: Every appendix goes to histology, labelled at hand-off and checked aloud.

med.surgx.app-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.app-step-17.caption: Close the fascia at every port of 10 mm or more to prevent a port-site hernia.

med.surgx.app-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.app-step-18.caption: Tension-free skin closure and a dressing that stays on for 48 hours.

med.surgx.app-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.app-step-19.caption: Write the note at once and hand over the plan in person.

med.surgx.hern-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.hern-step-03.caption: Antibiotic within the hour before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.hern-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.hern-step-04.caption: Supine and flat (or slightly head down), one arm out at no more than 90 degrees, strap across the thighs.

med.surgx.hern-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.hern-step-06.caption: Open along the fibres, protect the nerve beneath.

med.surgx.hern-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.hern-step-07.caption: Sling the cord, identify and preserve all three nerves.

med.surgx.hern-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.hern-step-08.caption: High dissection of the indirect sac; invert a direct one.

med.surgx.hern-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.hern-step-12.caption: Record every specimen, including none sent.

med.surgx.hern-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.hern-step-14.caption: Write it now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.cs-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.cs-step-01.caption: Consent and identity with the awake woman.

med.surgx.cs-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.cs-step-03.caption: Antibiotic BEFORE incision, not after cord clamping.

med.surgx.cs-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.cs-step-04.caption: Left lateral tilt of about 15 degrees until delivery, to take the uterus off the vena cava; arms out on padded boards.

med.surgx.cs-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.cs-step-06.caption: Blunt layered entry, open peritoneum high.

med.surgx.cs-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.cs-step-08.caption: Hand under the head plus fundal pressure.

med.surgx.cs-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.cs-step-09.caption: Uterotonic, then complete placenta and empty cavity.

med.surgx.cs-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.cs-step-11.caption: Inspect both tubes and ovaries and record.

med.surgx.cs-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.cs-step-12.caption: Check the angles and the suture line.

med.surgx.cs-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.cs-step-13.caption: Measure, not estimate; say it aloud.

med.surgx.cs-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.cs-step-15.caption: Close the sheath; fat only if over 2 cm.

med.surgx.cs-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.cs-step-17.caption: Check rhesus status and give anti-D if needed.

med.surgx.thyr-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.thyr-step-02.caption: The operation matches the MDT decision and the diagnosis.

med.surgx.thyr-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.thyr-step-04.caption: Antibiotic within the hour before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.thyr-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.thyr-step-07.caption: Flaps above the anterior jugular veins, open the midline.

med.surgx.thyr-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.thyr-step-08.caption: Get the vagal signal before dissection.

med.surgx.thyr-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.thyr-step-09.caption: Protect the external branch, tie close to the gland.

med.surgx.thyr-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.thyr-step-10.caption: Keep each parathyroid on its blood supply.

med.surgx.thyr-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.thyr-step-11.caption: Find, confirm and trace the nerve before dividing anything.

med.surgx.thyr-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.thyr-step-12.caption: Nerve in view at the most dangerous point.

med.surgx.thyr-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.thyr-step-13.caption: Confirm the signal before starting the second side.

med.surgx.thyr-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.thyr-step-14.caption: Orient the intact specimen for the pathologist.

med.surgx.thyr-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.thyr-step-15.caption: Check after a Valsalva or pressure rise.

med.surgx.thyr-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.thyr-step-19.caption: Hand over the airway and calcium plan; haematoma kit at the bed.

med.surgx.chole-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.chole-step-04.caption: Head up about 20 degrees and left side down, so the bowel falls away from the gallbladder; arms tucked, foot board and thigh strap.

med.surgx.thyr-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.thyr-step-05.caption: Shoulder roll with the neck extended to open the neck; head up about 15 degrees to reduce venous bleeding; arms tucked.

med.surgx.hmd-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.hmd-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.hmd-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.hmd-step-02.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.hmd-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.hmd-step-03.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.hmd-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.hmd-step-04.caption: Lithotomy: hips flexed about 90 degrees and abducted, legs raised together into padded stirrups, buttocks just over the end of the table, arms out no more than 90 degrees.

med.surgx.hmd-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.hmd-step-06.caption: Calculate the safe dose, infiltrate circumferentially, wait for the adrenaline.

med.surgx.hmd-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.hmd-step-08.caption: Know the two sphincters before cutting.

med.surgx.hmd-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.hmd-step-09.caption: Stop and biopsy when the findings change the diagnosis.

med.surgx.hmd-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.hmd-step-12.caption: Transfix above the dentate line, leave a cuff.

med.surgx.hmd-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.hmd-step-14.caption: Check every wound and the calibre.

med.surgx.hmd-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.hmd-step-15.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.hmd-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.hmd-step-17.caption: Soft stools, warm soaks, warning signs.

med.surgx.hmd-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.hmd-step-18.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.tons-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.tons-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.tons-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.tons-step-02.caption: The investigation that justifies the operation is on display.

med.surgx.tons-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.tons-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.tons-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.tons-step-05.caption: Agree the airway, the throat pack is a counted item.

med.surgx.tons-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.tons-step-06.caption: Supine with a shoulder roll and the head extended on a head ring; surgeon seated at the head with a headlight; both arms tucked.

med.surgx.tons-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.tons-step-07.caption: Head drape with both eyes taped and padded; only the face and mouth exposed.

med.surgx.tons-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.tons-step-08.caption: Full view, teeth protected, ventilation unchanged.

med.surgx.tons-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.tons-step-12.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.tons-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.tons-step-14.caption: Bleeding risk and what bleeding looks like.

med.surgx.tons-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.tons-step-15.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.tkr-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.tkr-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.tkr-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.tkr-step-02.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.tkr-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.tkr-step-03.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.tkr-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.tkr-step-04.caption: Ultraclean air, low traffic, implants opened late.

med.surgx.tkr-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.tkr-step-05.caption: Supine, tourniquet high on the right thigh, a foot rest holding the knee at 90 degrees, a lateral thigh post, pressure points padded.

med.surgx.tkr-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.tkr-step-06.caption: Apply, decide aloud, record the time.

med.surgx.tkr-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.tkr-step-08.caption: Medial arthrotomy, protect the tendon insertion.

med.surgx.tkr-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.tkr-step-09.caption: Alignment guides, protect the back of the tibia.

med.surgx.tkr-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.tkr-step-10.caption: Equal, rectangular gaps in flexion and extension.

med.surgx.tkr-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.tkr-step-11.caption: Stability and range with the trials.

med.surgx.tkr-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.tkr-step-12.caption: Confirm type, size and side aloud.

med.surgx.tkr-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.tkr-step-13.caption: Cement safety pause, dry bone, hold still while it sets.

med.surgx.tkr-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.tkr-step-14.caption: Stop when the feel changes, find the extent.

med.surgx.tkr-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.tkr-step-17.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.tkr-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.tkr-step-18.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.tkr-step-20.title: Step 20
med.surgx.tkr-step-20.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.rhc-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.rhc-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.rhc-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.rhc-step-02.caption: The operation matches the MDT decision and the staging.

med.surgx.rhc-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.rhc-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.rhc-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.rhc-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.rhc-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.rhc-step-05.caption: Supine, both arms tucked and strapped; head down about 15 degrees and rolled left side down so the small bowel falls away from the right colon.

med.surgx.rhc-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.rhc-step-06.caption: Whole abdomen prepared from the nipple line to the groins.

med.surgx.rhc-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.rhc-step-08.caption: Ports on the LEFT, a hand's breadth apart.

med.surgx.rhc-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.rhc-step-11.caption: The mesocolic plane, duodenum identified early.

med.surgx.rhc-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.rhc-step-12.caption: Central vascular ligation, careful near the SMV.

med.surgx.rhc-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.rhc-step-13.caption: Free the colon fully, avoid the duodenum.

med.surgx.rhc-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.rhc-step-19.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.rhc-step-21.title: Step 21
med.surgx.rhc-step-21.caption: Close every 10 mm or larger fascial defect.

med.surgx.rhc-step-22.title: Step 22
med.surgx.rhc-step-22.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.rhc-step-23.title: Step 23
med.surgx.rhc-step-23.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.turp-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.turp-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.turp-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.turp-step-02.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.turp-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.turp-step-03.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.turp-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.turp-step-04.caption: Lithotomy under spinal anaesthesia: the patient awake, the anaesthetist at the head, irrigation bags hung low (about 60 cm).

med.surgx.turp-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.turp-step-06.caption: Inspect the whole bladder before resecting.

med.surgx.turp-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.turp-step-07.caption: Right fluid for the energy, lowest pressure, never force the sheath.

med.surgx.turp-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.turp-step-08.caption: Identify the orifices first, channel at 6 o'clock to the circular fibres.

med.surgx.turp-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.turp-step-10.caption: Never cut distal to the verumontanum.

med.surgx.turp-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.turp-step-11.caption: Watch for TUR syndrome, keep the pressure low.

med.surgx.turp-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.turp-step-12.caption: Evacuate all chips, re-inspect the bladder.

med.surgx.turp-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.turp-step-15.caption: Free drainage before inflating the balloon, light pink return.

med.surgx.turp-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.turp-step-16.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.turp-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.turp-step-18.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.lapa-step-03.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.lapa-step-04.caption: Supine and flat, arms at the sides, a safety strap across the thighs, heels padded, the catheter draining below the table.

med.surgx.lapa-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.lapa-step-05.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.lapa-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.lapa-step-06.caption: Stay in the midline, open the peritoneum under direct vision.

med.surgx.lapa-step-08.title: Step 8

med.surgx.lapa-step-10.caption: Decide on physiology, control bleeding and contamination, close temporarily.

med.surgx.lapa-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.lapa-step-11.caption: Wash out all four quadrants and the pelvis, aspirate completely.

med.surgx.lapa-step-12.caption: Site it where the patient can see and care for it, tension-free and perfused.

med.surgx.lapa-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.lapa-step-15.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.tah-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.tah-step-03.caption: Confirm pregnancy status and the work-up on the day.

med.surgx.tah-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.tah-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.tah-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.tah-step-06.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.tah-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.tah-step-07.caption: Open high, away from the bladder.

med.surgx.tah-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.tah-step-09.caption: Traction, divide the round ligament, open the broad ligament.

med.surgx.tah-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.tah-step-10.caption: See the ureter before taking pelvic pedicles.

med.surgx.tah-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.tah-step-11.caption: Decide conserve or remove; clamp close to the uterus when conserving.

med.surgx.tah-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.tah-step-12.caption: Push the bladder down before the lower pedicles.

med.surgx.tah-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.tah-step-13.caption: Clamp close to the uterus, the ureter is just lateral and below.

med.surgx.tah-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.tah-step-14.caption: Small bites medial to the last, secure the angles, close the vault.

med.surgx.tah-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.tah-step-15.caption: When the plane is lost, stop, call for help, consider subtotal.

med.surgx.tah-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.tah-step-17.caption: Measure, say it aloud, agree the next step.

med.surgx.tah-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.tah-step-19.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.tah-step-20.title: Step 20
med.surgx.tah-step-20.caption: Include the angles, continuous delayed-absorbable suture.

med.surgx.tah-step-21.title: Step 21
med.surgx.tah-step-21.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.tah-step-22.title: Step 22
med.surgx.tah-step-22.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.cd-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.cd-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.cd-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.cd-step-02.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.cd-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.cd-step-03.caption: Sitting up at about 45 degrees with the right arm behind the head, awake and comfortable.

med.surgx.cd-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.cd-step-04.caption: Use the safe triangle, confirm with ultrasound.

med.surgx.cd-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.cd-step-05.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.cd-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.cd-step-06.caption: Go over the top of the rib, aspirate to confirm.

med.surgx.cd-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.cd-step-07.caption: Never let go of the wire.

med.surgx.cd-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.cd-step-08.caption: Blunt dissection and a finger sweep, never a trocar.

med.surgx.cd-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.cd-step-10.caption: Account for every sharp and the guidewire.

med.surgx.cd-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.cd-step-11.caption: Swinging, bubbling or draining, then an X-ray.

med.surgx.cd-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.cd-step-12.caption: Hand over what to watch and when to call.

med.surgx.mrm-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.mrm-step-05.caption: Supine with the right arm out on a padded board at 90 degrees and no more, a folded sheet under the right shoulder blade.

med.surgx.thr-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.thr-step-16.caption: Stop when the feel changes, find the extent.

med.surgx.cd-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.cd-step-09.caption: Secure it, bottle below the chest, tube under water.

med.surgx.csdh-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.csdh-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.csdh-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.csdh-step-02.caption: A fresh GCS and pupil check, the side read aloud from the scan and matched to the mark.

med.surgx.csdh-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.csdh-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.csdh-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.csdh-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.csdh-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.csdh-step-06.caption: Plan the burr holes over the thickest part of the collection, away from the midline.

med.surgx.csdh-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.csdh-step-07.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.csdh-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.csdh-step-08.caption: Perpendicular, steady pressure, let the clutch stop at the inner table.

med.surgx.csdh-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.csdh-step-09.caption: Dark fluid under pressure confirms the diagnosis; open the dura away from the brain.

med.surgx.csdh-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.csdh-step-10.caption: Irrigate gently along the dura until the return is clear.

med.surgx.csdh-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.csdh-step-11.caption: Separate stab, secure, keep the bag below the head.

med.surgx.csdh-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.csdh-step-13.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.csdh-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.csdh-step-14.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.csdh-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.csdh-step-15.caption: Write a baseline GCS and pupils and a trigger for urgent CT.

med.surgx.csdh-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.csdh-step-16.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.edh-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.edh-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.edh-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.edh-step-02.caption: Pupils and motor score immediately before induction, the side read aloud.

med.surgx.edh-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.edh-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.edh-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.edh-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.edh-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.edh-step-06.caption: A trauma flap that can be extended to a full decompression.

med.surgx.edh-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.edh-step-07.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.edh-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.edh-step-08.caption: Control the scalp edges as you go; blood loss starts here.

med.surgx.edh-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.edh-step-10.caption: Free the dura first, and make the flap big enough to expose the whole clot.

med.surgx.edh-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.edh-step-11.caption: Remove the clot AND control the source, then hitch the dura.

med.surgx.edh-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.edh-step-12.caption: Open the dura only if it is blue or tense, or the scan shows subdural blood.

med.surgx.edh-step-13.title: Step 13
med.surgx.edh-step-13.caption: If the brain swells above the inner table, leave the bone out, and make the opening large.

med.surgx.edh-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.edh-step-14.caption: A loose duraplasty gives the swollen brain room.

med.surgx.edh-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.edh-step-15.caption: Replace the bone only if the brain is slack; hitch the dura centrally.

med.surgx.edh-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.edh-step-17.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.edh-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.edh-step-18.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.edh-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.edh-step-19.caption: A written baseline and a trigger for urgent CT.

med.surgx.edh-step-20.title: Step 20
med.surgx.edh-step-20.caption: Record whether the flap is replaced or stored, and where.

med.surgx.evd-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.evd-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.evd-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.evd-step-02.caption: Read the ventricles and any shift before choosing the side.

med.surgx.evd-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.evd-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.evd-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.evd-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.evd-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.evd-step-05.caption: Supine with the head straight, nose to the ceiling, and the head of the table raised about 30 degrees.

med.surgx.evd-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.evd-step-06.caption: Kocher point, mid-pupillary line, just in front of the coronal suture.

med.surgx.evd-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.evd-step-07.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.evd-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.evd-step-08.caption: Keep the drill perpendicular to the skull.

med.surgx.evd-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.evd-step-09.caption: Open the dura only as much as the catheter needs.

med.surgx.evd-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.evd-step-11.caption: Zero at the tragus, measure the opening pressure, keep the system closed.

med.surgx.evd-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.evd-step-12.caption: A long tunnel and firm fixation reduce infection and pull-out.

med.surgx.evd-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.evd-step-14.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.evd-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.evd-step-15.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.evd-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.evd-step-16.caption: Re-level the drain whenever the head moves; a written trigger for calling.

med.surgx.evd-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.evd-step-17.caption: Write the opening pressure, the reference level and the drain height.

med.surgx.vps-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.vps-step-01.caption: Consent covers lifelong shunt dependence and likely revisions.

med.surgx.vps-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.vps-step-02.caption: Confirm the ventricle size, the side, the entry point and the valve chosen.

med.surgx.vps-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.vps-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.vps-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.vps-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.vps-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.vps-step-06.caption: Mark the cranial entry, the scalp incision and the abdominal incision before draping.

med.surgx.vps-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.vps-step-07.caption: Check accuracy on three bony landmarks before trusting navigation.

med.surgx.vps-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.vps-step-08.caption: One continuous field, no exposed skin along the tunnel.

med.surgx.vps-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.vps-step-09.caption: Open the implant only when needed, fresh gloves, it never touches skin.

med.surgx.vps-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.vps-step-10.caption: Curve the incision so no implant lies under the scar.

med.surgx.vps-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.vps-step-11.caption: Perpendicular, let the clutch stop at the inner table.

med.surgx.vps-step-12.title: Step 12
med.surgx.vps-step-12.caption: Enter under vision and see omentum or bowel, not preperitoneal fat.

med.surgx.vps-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.vps-step-14.caption: A small opening so CSF does not leak around the catheter.

med.surgx.vps-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.vps-step-15.caption: One clean pass to the planned depth; if no CSF, withdraw fully, never redirect inside the brain.

med.surgx.vps-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.vps-step-16.caption: Secure every joint, valve the right way round, see spontaneous distal flow.

med.surgx.vps-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.vps-step-17.caption: Free intraperitoneal placement with enough length.

med.surgx.vps-step-18.title: Step 18
med.surgx.vps-step-18.caption: Cloudy CSF means no implant: send CSF and place an external drain.

med.surgx.vps-step-19.title: Step 19
med.surgx.vps-step-19.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.vps-step-20.title: Step 20
med.surgx.vps-step-20.caption: Close the galea, and never leave an implant under the suture line.

med.surgx.vps-step-21.title: Step 21
med.surgx.vps-step-21.caption: Headache, vomiting and drowsiness are shunt-failure triggers.

med.surgx.vps-step-22.title: Step 22
med.surgx.vps-step-22.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.

med.surgx.ces-step-01.title: Step 1
med.surgx.ces-step-01.caption: Confirm identity, operation and side with the awake patient.

med.surgx.ces-step-02.title: Step 2
med.surgx.ces-step-02.caption: Read the level from the MRI aloud and match it to the mark; record leg, saddle and bladder function.

med.surgx.ces-step-03.title: Step 3
med.surgx.ces-step-03.caption: Everyone stops and confirms before the first cut.

med.surgx.ces-step-04.title: Step 4
med.surgx.ces-step-04.caption: Antibiotic before incision plus VTE prophylaxis.

med.surgx.ces-step-05.title: Step 5
med.surgx.ces-step-05.caption: Prone on bolsters under the chest and pelvis so the abdomen hangs free, face in a padded headrest, knees padded.

med.surgx.ces-step-06.title: Step 6
med.surgx.ces-step-06.caption: Prepare widely from the incision outwards and let it dry before drapes and diathermy.

med.surgx.ces-step-07.title: Step 7
med.surgx.ces-step-07.caption: Count up from the sacrum on a lateral image before the incision.

med.surgx.ces-step-08.title: Step 8
med.surgx.ces-step-08.caption: Remove enough bone and ligament to reach the disc without pulling on a compressed sac; keep the facets.

med.surgx.ces-step-09.title: Step 9
med.surgx.ces-step-09.caption: Retract gently only once there is room; keep the rongeur at a controlled depth.

med.surgx.ces-step-10.title: Step 10
med.surgx.ces-step-10.caption: Probe under the sac, into the foramen and up and down the canal.

med.surgx.ces-step-11.title: Step 11
med.surgx.ces-step-11.caption: Repair, reinforce, test with Valsalva, tell the ward.

med.surgx.ces-step-14.title: Step 14
med.surgx.ces-step-14.caption: Count before closure; any discrepancy stops the closure.

med.surgx.ces-step-15.title: Step 15
med.surgx.ces-step-15.caption: Tension-free closure with a clean dressing.

med.surgx.ces-step-16.title: Step 16
med.surgx.ces-step-16.caption: Include saddle sensation and bladder function in the baseline and the trigger for an urgent MRI.

med.surgx.ces-step-17.title: Step 17
med.surgx.ces-step-17.caption: Write the operation note now and hand over the plan.
